# ADR 0002: Sealed RepaymentMethod with a pure schedule engine

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Loan amortisation and repayment service

## Context

Several amortisation methods; adding one must not break the others.

## Decision

Model methods as a sealed interface of records and compute schedules in a pure function with exhaustive switches.

## Consequences

Compiler-checked completeness; parameterised tests over 1,000 real cases.

## Alternatives considered

Strategy beans looked up by name (no exhaustiveness).
